# Paper B: Test Fixture

## Introduction

This paper proposes an alternative model for the same testing purpose.
We ask whether a nonlinear model improves on the linear baseline.

## Method

We use gradient boosted trees to estimate the coefficients.
The training sample covers 2015 through 2022.

## Results

The model achieves an R-squared of 0.91 on the holdout set.
We conclude that the nonlinear specification improves fit on this fixture.
